lines.name: Emily
lines.en: Good morning! Where are you flying to today?

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: Bangkok. Great! May I see your passport, please?
lines.ko: 방콕이요. 좋아요! 여권 좀 보여 주시겠어요?

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: Thank you. Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 창가 자리로 드릴까요, 통로 자리로 드릴까요?

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: A window seat. OK! How many bags are you checking in?
lines.ko: 창가 자리요. 알겠습니다! 부치실 짐은 몇 개예요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Just one suitcase. Here it is.

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: Please put it on the scale. Are there any batteries or power banks in your suitcase?
lines.ko: 저울 위에 올려 주세요. 가방 안에 배터리나 보조 배터리 있나요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, there are no batteries in my suitcase.

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: Good. It's twenty kilograms, so it's fine. Here's your boarding pass. Do you know where your gate is?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 20킬로그램이라 괜찮아요. 탑승권 여기 있어요. 탑승구가 어딘지 아세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I can see it on my boarding pass.

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: Right. It's Gate twenty-three. Boarding starts at nine thirty. Do you have any other questions?
lines.ko: 맞아요. 23번 탑승구예요. 탑승은 9시 30분에 시작해요. 다른 궁금한 점 있으세요?

lines.name: Emily
lines.en: OK! Have a nice flight, and enjoy Bangkok!
lines.ko: 알겠습니다! 즐거운 비행 되시고, 방콕에서 좋은 시간 보내세요!
